newsitem.title: USA: AT&T, SBC talks unravelling - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: AT&T, SBC talks unravelling - WSJ.

text.p: A possible deal to merge AT&T Corp and SBC Communications Corp appears to be quickly eroding, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Friday's electronic edition, the Journal said that talks have bogged down over a number of issues, and now some insiders believe the chances of crafting a deal are slim at best.
"There is a definite sense that things are bogging down," one unnamed executive close to the deal told the Journal. "People are beginning to realize that this is a daunting task."
The deal apparently is unravelling among concerns about opposition from federal regulators, the legal difficulties of getting SBC into the long-distance telephone business, and disarray at AT&T.

In addition, the companies have had difficulty coming up with a workable financial and management structure for a merged entity since neither is comfortable exposing their battle plans or finances to the other.
